title: "The audacity": The Valley fans criticize Jax Taylor for calling out Danny regarding his drinking "problems" - NewsBreak
text: The Valley Season 2 aired its latest episode on June 17, 2025. Episode 10 featured male cast members celebrating Jax Taylor's rehab milestone. After his 30 days at the center, he went to celebrate his achievement with some of the cast members. During the celebration, Jax Taylor, and a few other participants talked about their co-star Danny. Despite mentioning that he was not going to say anything about Danny, Jason confronted him. Along with him, Jax also confronted Danny, who, in return, said that he didn't have any "drinking" problem. Witnessing how Jax himself was there from his rehab, fans criticized his behavior towards Danny. The Valley fans took to the social media platform X, and criticized Jax Taylor, Jason and other cast members for their behavior with Danny. During episode 10, The Valley fans saw Jax Taylor's discussion with Danny, which later turned into a confrontation . He told Danny that he had an "issue" and that he was the "last person" who should be advising him about such things. ​ Listening to Jax, The Valley star Danny said that he didn't have any such issue. Later, Jason Caperna also joined Jax in confronting Danny. He shared with the cameras that being around people who "lie" about their alcohol consumption could be "dangerous." Referring to Danny , Jason said that as he drove Jax to the mental health facility, he should also be taking Danny there. Seeing how they targeted Danny and confronted him, while Jax was already there from the rehab, The Valley fans criticized the cast members' behavior. To learn more about the latest episode, fans can stream The Valley Season 2 Episode 10 on Bravo. ​
